components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Cobalt action for refresh, submit, and authorized operations.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #8ca9ff; color: #10131a; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9px; font: 600 .82rem 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease, outline-color 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #b4c5ff; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8ca9ff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Glass control for close and secondary refresh actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .045); color: #f2f4f7; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(242, 244, 247, .22); border-radius: 9px; font: 600 .82rem 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(130%); transition: background-color 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(140, 169, 255, .14); border-color: rgba(140, 169, 255, .5); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8ca9ff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: Primary queue, intake, and staff-operation work area.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(22, 28, 37, .72); color: #f2f4f7; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(242, 244, 247, .12); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 24px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, .34); backdrop-filter: blur(26px) saturate(125%); }

components.name: Field
components.description: Dark raised field with explicit focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; color: rgba(242, 244, 247, .68); font: .75rem 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 46px; padding: 11px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(242, 244, 247, .22); border-radius: 9px; background: rgba(7, 10, 15, .35); color: #f2f4f7; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8ca9ff; outline-offset: 3px; border-color: #8ca9ff; }

components.name: State Chip
components.description: Status word remains visible inside an accent wash.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; min-height: 25px; align-items: center; padding: 4px 9px; border: 1px solid rgba(140, 169, 255, .3); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(140, 169, 255, .14); color: #8ca9ff; font: .63rem 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; }

narrative.overview: CivicOS presents municipal work as a living service ledger. A strict Swiss grid keeps role, queue, status, and action legible; a restrained liquid-glass layer gives the active surface depth without turning every container into decoration. The world is dark because the NUI runs inside a game session, where a low-luminance canvas keeps the workbench quiet and the cobalt accent marks only attention and action.
keyCharacteristics: Cobalt as the single visual accent.
IBM Plex Sans for interface copy, IBM Plex Mono for data labels.
Glass reserved for surfaces and controls that need depth.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is the only visual accent; hierarchy comes from opacity, weight, and placement.

rules.name: The Tabular Truth Rule
rules.body: IDs, counts, and status values use IBM Plex Mono and tabular numerals so operations can be scanned without visual drift.

rules.name: The Material Rule
rules.body: Blur and translucency must explain a surface or control state; never add glass to empty decoration.

dos: Do keep the request queue and the new-request form in the first desktop viewport.
Do use opacity and spacing for hierarchy before adding color.
Do keep IDs, references, statuses, and counts tabular and aligned.
Do preserve keyboard focus, readable labels, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't introduce a second brand accent for ordinary state changes.
Don't hide operational status behind color-only chips.
Don't turn every element into a floating glass pill.
Don't add mobile-specific stacking or change existing NUI/API behavior without a new brief.
